tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: List every trade board (for example vacation rental, restaurant operations, legal practice) with its key, how many companies were recorded buying ads on its shows, and how many names are public. Use a key with get_trade_board.

tools.name: get_trade_board
tools.description: Public sponsor names on one trade board, with how many shows each covers, the longest observed run and the last observed date, plus the shows on the board. Free boards show a sample of names.

tools.name: search_sponsors
tools.description: Find companies with a public sponsorship page by domain or name (for example "squarespace" or "stayfi.com"). Returns up to 10 matches with their domains; pass a domain to get_sponsor.

tools.name: get_sponsor
tools.description: One company's public sponsorship record: the shows it was observed on with first and last dates, the trade boards where its name is public, selected recorded offers and recorded promo codes.
